product_from_film: Ablad uses a chat interface to create and edit WordPress sites, with examples of setup, plugin data and article creation.
explains_well: The demo connects a plumbing-site request to setup states and a finished-looking website, then keeps chat beside later edits.
unclear: The beach comedy continues in an inset during a dense demo, while article scheduling and image creation are asserted faster than their results can be read.
scenario: Create a plumbing website and use chat to work with plugins, search data, articles and page design.
product_clear_basis: Create Your WordPress Site and the request box are visible at 15s; later setup and website states clarify the task.

sound.detail: The draft combines a comic interruption with claims about WordPress creation, setup, plugin data, SEO articles and chat editing. Opening names are garbled, so visible product labels guide interpretation. Delivery, music, effects and sync were not heard.
sound.visual_relation: V01–V06 broadly follow the demo claims and waitlist close.
sound.evidence: Local 465-speech.json; usable task language with transcription errors.
